scenes.tekst: Already split your figure? Can that knee still bend?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: This robot is already in parts: a body and two separate legs.
scenes.label: ALREADY SPLIT

scenes.tekst: Click the leg you want to bend.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Turn the view to the side. The hinge turns around the way you look.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Shift and right click on the knee. The 3D cursor jumps there.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: In Click Joints Pro, go to Figure joints and click Knee.
scenes.label: STEP 4

scenes.tekst: It cuts the leg in two and builds a hinge right at the cursor.
scenes.label: HINGE

scenes.tekst: Show bend range shows how far the knee can swing.
scenes.label: CHECK

scenes.tekst: Elbow and Ankle work the same way.
scenes.label: SAME FOR

scenes.tekst: Your parts stay as they are. Now they move.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different. Print a test joint first.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
